name: biomanufacturing
description: Pathway optimisation in a microbial host, as published for the SYNBIOCHEM pipeline: (2S)-pinocembrin in E. coli, Carbonell et al., Communications Biology 2018. The quantities and instruments below are the ones that pipeline actually uses. Earlier versions of this file described a different case and attributed it to this one; see the review note.

design_to_build.note: Same contract, same check, different root. Here a construct does not trace back to a field site but to a registered part and a chassis strain. The chain is as rigid, the far end is a registry entry rather than a freezer.

entities.why: a part without a registry accession cannot be re-obtained, and a construct built from it cannot be reproduced by anyone else
the same construct in a different chassis is a different experiment; the Learn phase cannot pool the two

test_to_learn.note: The same three, stated for a titre rather than a fluorescence. Carbonell's pipeline gates peaks by LOD and LOQ against a calibration curve, which is this use case's form of 'within range'.

entities.why: a titre below the limit of quantification is not a small titre, and a single colony is not a measurement of a strain

build_to_test.method_hint: Sanger verification of the assembled plasmid

test_to_learn.method_hint: Acquity UPLC - Xevo TQ-S, MRM quantification against a calibration curve, peaks processed with ProteoWizard and R

learn_to_design.method_hint: strain model prediction, with uncertainty, in the same unit as the measurement that will test it

instruments.name: Hamilton STAR
instruments.role: worklist-driven liquid handling, ligase cycling assembly

instruments.name: Acquity UPLC - Xevo TQ-S (QqQ)
instruments.role: MRM quantification of the pathway product

notes: Biomass is required at Build -> Test because the Test -> Learn contract demands normalisation per gDW. A peak area without a biomass basis cannot become a titre, which is the failure the flash deck calls 'peak area is not flux'.
Carrying 'sequence_verified' as a dimensionless boolean measurement keeps one measurement shape for everything, instead of a special case per data type.
review: The titre here is volumetric, mg/L, because that is what the published pipeline reports. A titre normalised per gram dry weight separates a strain that makes more from a strain that simply grows more, and this file used to require mg/gDW for that reason - but that was our preference, not this use case's practice, and a profile states what a use case requires. Whether to require both is a question for the use case owner, not a decision for whoever edits this file.
